Use any or all of it with your current systems. Talk to us Get started Want Adapt engineers on your team? AI Transformation Services The company agent answers in Slack which accounts might churn this quarter: Northwind, Fernhill, Larkspur and Halden, with the list attached. It called Claude through the model gateway, scored the accounts in a sandbox and kept reports/at-risk.csv in storage.
